news.title: Pakistan win warm-up match ahead of England Test series
news.summary: Pakistan warmed up for their first Test against England at Headingley from Wednesday with a seven-wicket win over a County Select XI as Saud Shakeel hit an unbeaten hundred and Imam-ul-Haq scored 80.

news.title: Djokovic knocked out early in Cincinnati after struggling in sapping heat

news.summary_tr: Novak Djokovic, Wimbledon'dan bu yana ilk maçında, Cincinnati Açık'ta üç setlik zorlu mücadelede Thiago Agustin Tirante'ye yenildiği için fiziksel olarak zorlandı ve yenilgiye uğradı.

news.title: Veerman hoopt vurig op transfer naar Dortmund: 'Ze moeten tempo maken, hè?'
news.summary: Joey Veerman hoopt dat zijn mogelijke transfer naar Borussia Dortmund doorgang vindt, zo liet de controleur van PSV zaterdagavond blijken na de overwinning op Excelsior . De Duitse topclub is in de markt voor Veerman. 'Het is een super mooie club.'
